claims.claim: Fiscal Q3 2026 net sales rose 7%, underlying sales 6%, and underlying orders 7%; Software & Systems sales rose 11% with power demand cited as a driver.
The Q3 10-Q attributes underlying growth to both 3% higher volume and 3% higher price, providing direct evidence of current operating demand and some price realization.

risks.risk: Q3 cost of sales included an $82M tariff-refund benefit, so reported margin expansion should not be treated as entirely recurring.

unknowns.unknown: Current sources do not establish security-level valuation attractiveness or isolate long-run pricing power from mix and inflation recovery.

claims.claim: Emerson raised its 2026 outlook after Q3 sales, margin, earnings and cash flow exceeded expectations; operating cash flow rose 34% and free cash flow 36% year over year.

risks.risk: Raised expectations increase the future delivery bar; geopolitical and regional demand conditions remain variable.
